notes.title: Wishlist Strife Lords today!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3429300/Strife_Lords/
In this epic turn-based multiplayer board game adventure with Strife Lords! Play in 2, 4, 6, or 8 player modes, commanding footmen, spearmen, and a powerful king. Capture farm and mine tiles for gold, control major sites, and outmaneuver your rivals. Strategize to become the ultimate Strife Lord.

In Strife Lords, you must make a strategy to maintain your army and control the board. Capture farm and mine tiles to amass gold, essential for fueling your conquests, as you can't go on the offensive without paying your units off. Footmen are the weakest, but in groups of 3s will be effective in battle. Spearmen are more aggressive, but they have a weaker time on the defensive. Kings are the strongest unit of the time, being strong in offense and defense. They will all die the same ways in battles, if the battle doesn't go your way. Roll the dice to see how many units you placed in a battle will die, and suffer the consequences.

As you navigate the board, form alliances, betray rivals, and outmaneuver your opponents in a quest for dominance over the three main sites to win the game. Will you be aggressive? Or will you slowly chip away at your enemy's units until they have nothing left? There are many different strategies to win. But all that matters is who controls the vital tiles for victory.

Key Features:

    Multiplayer Modes: Play in 2, 4, 6, or 8 player modes for diverse gameplay experiences with online play.

    Objective-Based Gameplay: Control all three major sites on the board to achieve victory. But how you get there, and what you sacrifice to get there is up to you.

    Resource Management: Capture farm and mine tiles to generate gold for your conquests. Units eat up food when you have it when moving, and battles use up fresh steel. Not using those resources will generate gold over time.

    Strategic Depth: Form alliances, betray rivals, and outmaneuver opponents in a constantly evolving game.

    Graphics: Cell shaded graphics and vibrant 3D models that are good to look at while thinking about your next move.

    Music: 2 main tracks to set the mood for you and your opponents.

    Perfect for Game Nights: Ideal for friendly competition with online matches.
